svg.title: J5 No-key run and model failures

g.text: J5 No-key run and model failures
[the whole call takes more than 6 s, or the network fails]
Rejected when: empty or over 900 characters; a number
not in the draft or the file; a capitalised name not in
them; a risky word (ticket, discount, free, refund...)
the draft did not use; a medicine; an unknown doctor;
a fact from the draft missing; the wrong script.
askModel() resolves to null in every case above
same facts and wording as a run with the key; only the model's rewording is missing
